cohort: A total of 156 patients admitted with Hemorrhoids, fissures and fistula in ano in J. A. Hospital, Gwalior underwent surgery, evenly split between Diode Laser ablation and conventional surgical techniques.
finding: Laser surgery resulted in significantly shorter mean surgery duration, less intraoperative blood loss, lower postoperative bleeding, and reduced postoperative pain, infection, and chances of recurrence compared to conventional surgical techniques.
